title: Extra Crispy Norwegian Beef Grill
description: A buttery, crunchy, midnight-craving Norwegian dish featuring paccheri pasta and a char-grilled beef patty.

ingredients.name: Beef patty
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality beef option, such as ribeye or sirloin

instructions: Prepare a charcoal grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the beef patty with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
In a small bowl, mix together gluten-free flour and egg to create a breading mixture.
Dip the beef patty in the breading mixture, coating it evenly.
Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Sear the beef patty for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, cook the paccheri pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a small saucepan, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter over low heat.
Add the chopped parsley and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until wilted.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked beef patty on top of the paccheri pasta, then spoon the parsley butter over the top.
Serve immediately, garnished with lemon wedges and a sprinkle of char-grill seasoning.
